== Course of events ==

Having pursued the White Rabbit down a large rabbit-hole and tumbled through a deep well filled with curious furnishings, Alice finds herself in a long, low hall lit by hanging lamps. There, among the many locked doors that line the corridor, she becomes possessed of a sudden curiosity upon observing the White Rabbit pass before her—a creature of most extraordinary appearance, dressed in a waistcoat and carrying a watch. This sight stirs Alice from the dullness that had settled upon her while sitting with her sister, transforming her wondering attention from the ordinary world into something far more pressing and strange.

The White Rabbit's peculiar costume and timepiece prove irresistible to Alice's inquisitive nature. In that moment, the tedium of her former situation dissolves entirely, replaced by the urgent desire to follow this remarkable creature further into the mysteries of this bewildering place. Thus does Alice's curiosity, kindled by the White Rabbit's extraordinary appearance, set her upon the course that will draw her ever deeper into the wonders and trials that await her in this topsy-turvy realm.
